kicker: THE FASTEST WAY TO BE LIKED
title: Make people feel *interesting*

text: Try to sound clever. Nobody remembers your fun fact. They remember how you made them *feel.*

head: Meeting someone new
r: "What's the best part of what you do?"

head: They share a win
r: "What did it take to pull that off?"

label: THE RULE
head: Ask about what they're proud of
sub: Then let them talk for 2 full minutes.
